## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复 macOS 打包遗漏 `yauzl`、`pend`、`buffer-crc32` 和 `eslint-visitor-keys` 运行时依赖导致应用启动失败的问题。
- 将这些运行时依赖明确锁定为生产依赖，并在打包前检查 `node_modules`、npm 依赖树和模块可加载性；打包烟测现在会检查 app.asar 的完整依赖闭包。
- 改进打包启动烟测：启动失败时保留受限的 stdout/stderr 诊断，报告真实主进程错误并只清理本次测试进程组。

- Fixed macOS packages that failed at launch because the `yauzl` runtime dependency closure was incomplete (`pend`, `buffer-crc32` and `eslint-visitor-keys` were omitted).
- Declared the runtime modules as pinned production dependencies and added packaging preflight checks for the checkout, npm dependency tree and module loading. The packaged smoke test now checks the app.asar dependency closure.
- Improved packaged startup diagnostics with bounded stdout/stderr capture and process-group cleanup scoped to the smoke test.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。有运行实例时，关闭窗口或普通退出会保留后台服务；请完成任务、等待实例结束且管理器彻底退出后再安装新版。账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Closing the window or using ordinary Quit keeps background services alive while instances are running. Finish active work and wait for the instances and manager to exit completely before installing an update. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

支持 Codex 桌面 / CLI，以及 macOS 官方原生 Claude Code CLI 的 API Key、Bearer 和兼容 Anthropic Messages 网关连接；客户端需单独安装。Claude 的订阅 OAuth、云模式、npm 包装启动器和 Claude Desktop（Chat / Cowork / Code）尚未接入。Claude 模型由连接明确声明，会话管理当前只读，不使用 Codex 的修改、同步、修复或统计能力。Codex 桌面菜单和语言适配取决于版本，Fast 还取决于模型和服务商能力。

Codex desktop / CLI and the official native Claude Code CLI on macOS are supported. Claude connections use API Keys, Bearer tokens or gateways compatible with Anthropic Messages. Install clients separately. Claude subscription OAuth, cloud modes, npm wrapper launchers and Claude Desktop (Chat / Cowork / Code) are not integrated. Claude models must be declared by the connection; its session management is read-only and does not use Codex mutation, synchronization, repair or statistics features. Codex desktop menus and language integration depend on version; Fast also depends on model and provider capabilities.

## 验证来源 / Verification

本版本通过源码依赖预检、TypeScript 构建、项目测试、Go sidecar 测试以及 macOS arm64 打包启动烟测后发布。GitHub Actions 会在匹配的版本提交上生成 DMG、ZIP 和 `SHA256SUMS.txt`；发布完成后补充对应的版本标签、完整提交、构建记录和校验文件链接。模拟服务验证不等同于真实上游账号验收；未验证的平台、客户端形态与登录方式不得列为已支持。

This release is validated with the packaging dependency preflight, TypeScript build, project tests, Go sidecar tests and a macOS arm64 packaged startup smoke test. GitHub Actions generates the DMG, ZIP and `SHA256SUMS.txt` from the matching version commit; the published release records the version tag, full commit, build run and checksum file links. Mock-service checks do not establish real upstream account acceptance; unvalidated platforms, client variants and login methods remain unsupported.
